purpose: Authoritative algebra data for an independently implemented necessary native-circuit coupon screen; not a general BBS constructor or decoder search.
positive_hermitian_convention: P(x,z)=i^popcount(x&z) X^x Z^z; phase sign is an additional +/-1
isometry: |000>_L is unique simultaneous +1 eigenvector of the 21 signed stabilizers and all three logical_z, with first nonzero computational amplitude positive; V|v1v2v3>=logical_x[0]^v1 logical_x[1]^v2 logical_x[2]^v3 |000>_L.

total_decoder.x_syndrome: t=(row parity, XOR of occupied nonzero row labels), in z_all,z_bit0,z_bit1,z_bit2 order
total_decoder.x_section: minimum row count, ties by lexicographic sorted row-label tuple in order001,010,011,100,101,110,111; put X on first site of each selected row
total_decoder.z_section: independent minimum-weight Z pattern for each row's consecutive-XX syndrome; ties by lexicographic sorted physical-site tuple
total_decoder.operator_order: D_Z D_X, positive Hermitian representative; global correction phase is irrelevant to the decoded channel
total_decoder.variant_not_selected_by_results: Only with all17 horizontal XX syndromes zero: t=(0,kappa) uses kappa2 rows4,6; kappa3 rows4,7; kappa4 rows2,6; kappa5 rows2,7. All other t use lex. This optional point must be separately preregistered before results.

pure_X_coupon_quotient.scope: Within each fixed syndrome, a common Pauli D only translates the four raw_q classes. This is not a full decoder table or a full noisy-channel result.
